autism.definition: n. (psychiatry) an abnormal absorption with the self; marked by communication disorders and short attention span and inability to treat others as people
autism.translation:
n. 孤独症
[医] 孤独癖, 自我中心主义

autistic.definition: s. characteristic of or affected with autism
autistic.translation: [医] 孤独的, 自我中心的

autistics.definition:
plural of autistic
s. characteristic of or affected with autism
autistics.translation: (autistic 的复数) [医] 孤独的, 自我中心的
